defects.current: The contract stores conceptGroups for all 121 rows, but the evaluator reads requiredGroups. Only ten semantic overrides supply requiredGroups, so 111 requirements receive no concept-level assertion.
defects.evidence: 121 contract rows have conceptGroups; ten overrides have requiredGroups; the current verifier still reports 121 Complete.
defects.officialBasis: Every official requirement must be checked for its required concepts in visible CORE teaching.
defects.impact: A false-positive release gate can approve missing compulsory content.
defects.suggestedFix: Use one field name and require at least one independently testable concept group for every requirement.
defects.regressionTest: Delete one required concept from a non-override lesson and assert the coverage verifier fails.

defects.current: All 121 requirements use the same two whole assessment-data files as evidence; the evaluator only checks that those files contain text unless an override adds assessmentGroups.
defects.evidence: There is exactly one assessmentEvidence bundle across 121 requirements; 111 rows have no requirement-specific assessment assertion.
defects.officialBasis: Each requirement needs direct question-level assessment evidence.
defects.impact: A requirement can pass without ever being directly assessed.
defects.suggestedFix: Store stable question IDs and requirement-specific expected concepts in the contract.
defects.regressionTest: Remove the mapped question or its core term and assert only the owning requirement fails.

defects.current: All Notes fields are empty; prerequisites and risk fields are absent; all per-row forbiddenPatterns arrays are empty; visual evidence is not represented.
defects.evidence: Counts: notes 0/121, prerequisites 0/121, risk metadata 0/121, non-empty per-row forbidden patterns 0/121.
defects.officialBasis: The audit interface must preserve official Notes, prerequisites, prohibited semantics, visual evidence and risk.
defects.impact: The contract cannot support the planned completeness, order, visual or risk checks.
defects.suggestedFix: Extend every row with sourced Notes, prerequisite IDs, risk, direct visual IDs and forbidden patterns.
defects.regressionTest: Schema validation must reject empty mandatory fields and dangling evidence IDs.

defects.current: workedExampleEvidence is never evaluated and CORE validation only asks whether each lesson contains some CORE region, not whether the requirement is taught in CORE.
defects.evidence: The evaluator has no workedExampleEvidence read and combines Markdown with all non-OPTIONAL HTML for term searches.
defects.officialBasis: Each requirement needs requirement-specific CORE teaching, worked example, practice/MS and assessment evidence.
defects.impact: A generic CORE block elsewhere in the lesson can satisfy the gate.
defects.suggestedFix: Evaluate evidence anchors and delivery role per requirement, not per lesson.
defects.regressionTest: Move the required section to OPTIONAL and assert the requirement fails.

defects.current: The sequence verifier tests six named repairs rather than a complete prerequisite graph or first-use inventory.
defects.evidence: Independent term scanning found additional assessment-before-teaching and structure inversions that the verifier accepts.
defects.officialBasis: Definitions, representations and structures must precede application and assessment.
defects.impact: The current release gate cannot detect most new sequence regressions.
defects.suggestedFix: Make the prerequisite graph and first-use scan the verifier's source of truth.
defects.regressionTest: Move a prerequisite after its first dependent lesson in a temporary copy and assert failure.

defects.current: The lessons teach generic lossy/lossless, RLE and dictionary compression but do not teach how bitmap images and vector graphics are compressed; vector compression has no method at all.
defects.evidence: Independent named-term and semantic review of L013-L014; image and sound are mostly used as choice contexts.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 1.3 requires how text, bitmap, vector and sound files can be compressed, including RLE.
defects.impact: A compulsory syllabus method is missing from visible teaching.
defects.suggestedFix: Add distinct worked mechanisms for all four file types, including bitmap RLE and vector object/property compression.
defects.regressionTest: Require CORE lesson, worked example, practice/MS and direct assessment evidence for all four media types.

defects.current: The fetch-execute flow is described in prose but formal register-transfer notation is not taught or used in the lessons.
defects.evidence: No register-transfer phrase or transfer operator is present in L043-L044 Markdown/HTML; the assessment uses MAR <- PC later.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 4.1 requires candidates to describe and use register-transfer notation for the fetch-execute cycle.
defects.impact: Students are assessed in a notation they were not formally taught.
defects.suggestedFix: Teach explicit transfers such as MAR <- PC and MDR <- Memory[MAR], including brackets and sequencing.
defects.regressionTest: Require notation in CORE, a traced example, practice and assessment; reject prose-only evidence.

defects.current: L047-L048 accurately repair four high-risk instructions but do not teach all official instruction groups or the full specified set; MOV, STO, SUB, INC, DEC, OUT and END are not formally covered.
defects.evidence: Independent comparison against the Version 2 instruction table and group list.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 4.2 specifies instruction groups and LDM, LDD, LDI, LDX, LDR, MOV, STO, ADD, SUB, INC, DEC, JMP, CMP, CMI, JPE, JPN, IN, OUT and END.
defects.impact: Compulsory assembly operations remain absent despite the local coverage gate passing.
defects.suggestedFix: Teach every group and every specified instruction with official effects and operands.
defects.regressionTest: Assert every opcode/group in visible CORE Markdown and HTML plus direct assessment evidence.

defects.current: Limit check is absent; the official validation method is neither defined, distinguished from range check, nor used.
defects.evidence: Exact-term scan of L070 Markdown and student HTML returned no limit-check teaching.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 6.2 explicitly includes range, format, length, presence, existence, limit and check digit.
defects.impact: Students cannot answer a direct limit-check question from the course.
defects.suggestedFix: Add definition, boundary distinction, example, practice and assessment.
defects.regressionTest: Require limit check in CORE and reject a list-only mention as sufficient evidence.

defects.current: L138 teaches normal, boundary and erroneous data; it never teaches or uses the official category name abnormal.
defects.evidence: Exact-term scan of the responsible lesson and direct comparison with the Version 2 Notes.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 12.3 requires normal, abnormal and extreme/boundary test data.
defects.impact: A locally substituted label can cause students to miss the official command-language category and creates inconsistent terminology with L146.
defects.suggestedFix: Teach abnormal as the official invalid-data category and extreme/boundary as the edge category; retain any synonym only as clarification.
defects.regressionTest: Require all three official category names in CORE, examples, practice and assessment.

defects.current: The performance lessons cover cores, bus width, clock speed and cache, but processor type is absent.
defects.evidence: Whole-project exact-term scan plus semantic review of L045 and L050.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 4.1 lists processor type and number of cores, bus width, clock speed and cache memory as performance factors.
defects.impact: One prescribed performance factor is not taught or assessed directly.
defects.suggestedFix: Add processor type with an architecture/workload boundary and compare it with number of cores.
defects.regressionTest: Require every official performance factor in CORE and direct assessment evidence.

defects.current: Security management is taught in student HTML but is absent from the L053-L054 Markdown source; the Markdown instead mentions antivirus as a utility.
defects.evidence: Cross-carrier search: HTML states user accounts, authentication and access rights; Markdown has no security-management teaching.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 5.1 requires security management as an OS task, and the audit requires Markdown and HTML agreement.
defects.impact: The maintained source and generated student page do not carry the same compulsory evidence.
defects.suggestedFix: Add OS security management to the maintained Markdown/generator source and keep it distinct from antivirus utilities.
defects.regressionTest: Require the same requirement-specific concepts in Markdown and visible CORE HTML independently.

defects.current: The course consistently uses sample resolution while the Version 2 syllabus term is sampling resolution.
defects.evidence: Terminology scan across L011-L012, HTML and Quiz 10.
defects.officialBasis: Official Section 1.2 instructs candidates to use sampling, sampling rate and sampling resolution.
defects.impact: The concept is correctly explained, but terminology differs from the authoritative vocabulary.
defects.suggestedFix: Use sampling resolution as the primary term and mention sample resolution only as a common synonym if retained.
defects.regressionTest: Official-term checker should require sampling resolution in CORE and assessment wording.

defects.current: L001-Q1 assesses a file header before bitmap file headers are taught in L008.
defects.evidence: Question and first formal CORE teaching locations compared by lesson number.
defects.officialBasis: Assessment should only require previously taught compulsory knowledge.
defects.impact: The first lesson contains a pre-teach assessment dependency.
defects.suggestedFix: Replace with an L001 storage-unit context or move header assessment to L008+.
defects.regressionTest: First-use verifier must reject assessment terms whose teaching lesson is later.

defects.current: The L081 monthly assessment requires a normalised three-table design, referential integrity and INNER JOIN before relational design and joins are taught through L082-L087.
defects.evidence: The assessment is scheduled at L081 while its required techniques occur later.
defects.officialBasis: Assessment must follow direct teaching and practice.
defects.impact: Students are asked to design and query material not yet taught.
defects.suggestedFix: Move the question to a later assessment or restrict it to concepts taught by L081.
defects.regressionTest: Map every assessment question to prerequisite lessons and reject later dependencies.

defects.current: AQ101-Q5 asks for flowchart symbols before L102 formally teaches them.
defects.evidence: Quiz 100 is issued before lesson 101.
defects.officialBasis: Notation must be taught before recall/application assessment.
defects.impact: A compulsory notation item is assessed one lesson early.
defects.suggestedFix: Move the item to AQ106 or teach it before Quiz 100.
defects.regressionTest: Question-to-first-teaching mapping must enforce lesson <= assessment lesson.

defects.current: Search and sorting algorithms operate on indexed arrays in L105-L106, but one-dimensional arrays are formally taught in L116.
defects.evidence: The algorithm lessons use list/array indexing before the data structure lesson.
defects.officialBasis: Data structures and indexing should precede algorithms that traverse and mutate them.
defects.impact: Learners must infer an undeclared representation while learning the algorithm.
defects.suggestedFix: Teach arrays earlier or explicitly establish the required array model before L105.
defects.regressionTest: Add semantic prerequisite edge L116 -> L105/L106 and reject backward schedule edges.

defects.current: AR112-Q1 requires ARRAY[1:50] OF STRING before L116 teaches array declarations.
defects.evidence: The stage review is at L113; formal array teaching is at L116.
defects.officialBasis: Stage reviews must not introduce new compulsory syntax.
defects.impact: A review assesses undeclared syntax.
defects.suggestedFix: Move the item after L116 or teach the declaration earlier.
defects.regressionTest: Stage-review mappings must reject later prerequisite lessons.

defects.current: The L121 monthly assessment compares stack, queue and linked list before L123-L124 teaches them.
defects.evidence: The assessment lesson number precedes both responsible lessons.
defects.officialBasis: ADT definitions and operations must precede comparative assessment.
defects.impact: The assessment requires untaught structures and trade-offs.
defects.suggestedFix: Move the question or move ADT teaching before the L121 checkpoint.
defects.regressionTest: Direct prerequisite mapping must include all three ADTs.

defects.current: The L141 monthly assessment compares waterfall, iterative and RAD before L143 teaches the development models.
defects.evidence: The assessment lesson number precedes the responsible CORE lesson.
defects.officialBasis: Development-model comparison must be taught before evaluation.
defects.impact: Students face an eight-mark evaluation before formal teaching.
defects.suggestedFix: Move the question after L143 or move the CORE lesson earlier.
defects.regressionTest: Assessment prerequisite check must fail when teachingLessons are later.

defects.current: L138 labels testing as Syllabus Section 11 although testing is in official Section 12.3.
defects.evidence: The coverage contract maps the relevant testing requirement to L138 while the page identity says Section 11.
defects.officialBasis: Student-facing syllabus identity must match the official section.
defects.impact: The page and generated metadata misclassify a compulsory topic.
defects.suggestedFix: Correct the source metadata and every generated reference.
defects.regressionTest: Cross-check lesson-declared section against contract ownership and HTML.

defects.current: The current eight-bit strings are correctly eight bits, but logical left 10110011 -> 01100110 is labelled 'Overflow: No' even though the discarded high 1 makes unsigned 179 x 2 exceed 255; the adjacent signed arithmetic panel labels the same bit movement as overflow.
defects.evidence: Full-resolution pixel inspection and independent recalculation.
defects.officialBasis: Fixed-width shift examples must state interpretation and apply overflow consistently.
defects.impact: The graphic teaches an internally inconsistent boundary rule.
defects.suggestedFix: State unsigned/signed interpretation explicitly and correct or remove the ambiguous overflow label.
defects.regressionTest: OCR/structured source assertion must recompute each panel's width, result and overflow flag.

defects.current: The image visibly contains ELSE and ENDIF, but the screen-reader transcript omits both tokens while claiming to be the infographic text alternative.
defects.evidence: Full-resolution image inspection compared with the student-visible accessibility transcript and OCR ledger.
defects.officialBasis: Image, transcript, alt text and lesson semantics must agree.
defects.impact: Screen-reader users receive incomplete pseudocode and a different concept from sighted users.
defects.suggestedFix: Regenerate the transcript from verified semantic source and include every structural token.
defects.regressionTest: Compare required image tokens with transcript tokens; require ELSE and ENDIF.

defects.current: At <=640 px, Stage 10 images are forced to 720 px with container overflow-x:auto; L051's shift image overrides this but becomes too small to read at 390 px.
defects.evidence: Rendered 390x844 scan plus CSS inspection; document overflow is zero but the infographic containers intentionally overflow.
defects.officialBasis: The stated acceptance requires no page or container horizontal overflow and readable text.
defects.impact: Most infographics require horizontal panning; the exception sacrifices legibility.
defects.suggestedFix: Adopt responsive image-specific layouts or responsive alternate assets instead of a global 720 px rule.
defects.regressionTest: At 390x844 assert container scrollWidth <= clientWidth and minimum readable text size.

defects.current: The existing register marks L051 shifts Approved with two reviews and no defect, yet independent inspection finds SCI-VIS-001.
defects.evidence: Current asset hash matches the Approved register row.
defects.officialBasis: Existing Approved status and matching hashes are evidence of identity, not semantic correctness.
defects.impact: The two-pass visual gate has a demonstrated false negative.
defects.suggestedFix: Reopen all visual rows for independent review and add deterministic calculation assertions.
defects.regressionTest: Mutation test the overflow flag and require the visual verifier to fail.

defects.current: The fixed two-row lesson toolbar occupies and overlays the lower part of the 390x844 viewport while reading lesson content.
defects.evidence: Rendered mobile screenshot of L051; the page adds bottom padding but the control still obscures content during scrolling.
defects.officialBasis: Controls must not overlap teaching content at the specified mobile viewport.
defects.impact: Visible reading area is reduced and text can sit behind the toolbar until further scrolling.
defects.suggestedFix: Collapse the toolbar or reserve non-overlapping layout space on narrow screens.
defects.regressionTest: Screenshot assertion at top, middle and end of representative long lessons.

defects.current: After generated repair/explanation blocks and topic labels are normalised away, seven L028-L040 lessons share an identical base scaffold; L008/L009 and L053/L059 form additional exact pairs.
defects.evidence: Deterministic Jaccard/template normalisation found exact equality in these groups; this is a review signal, not proof that all generated inserts are identical.
defects.officialBasis: Examples and practice should be specific enough to teach and transfer each lesson's concept.
defects.impact: Generic prompts can satisfy structural checks while providing shallow or repetitive learning.
defects.suggestedFix: Manually review the flagged groups and replace only genuinely generic examples/tasks with topic-specific work.
defects.regressionTest: Add a similarity gate as a warning and require human disposition for exact normalised matches.

defects.current: Twenty-two questions contain A1 marks without any M mark in the same question; several use A1 as a generic exact-answer mark after B points.
defects.evidence: Independent scan of all 968 questions; examples include L003-Q2, L088-Q4, L103-Q1 and AQ011-Q1.
defects.officialBasis: B/M/A codes should reflect independent knowledge, method and dependent accuracy consistently.
defects.impact: Inconsistent code semantics weakens marking reliability and follow-through behaviour.
defects.suggestedFix: Review the 22 flagged questions against the official mark-scheme convention and recode where necessary.
defects.regressionTest: Require an explicit dependency rationale for every A mark without M.

defects.current: Five logic questions offer follow-through guidance although every mark is coded B1; the dependency boundary is not expressed in the mark codes.
defects.evidence: 968-question scan found L036-Q3, L037-Q1, L037-Q2, L037-Q4 and L041-Q3.
defects.officialBasis: Follow-through should attach to a clear preceding calculated result/method.
defects.impact: Markers may apply FT inconsistently.
defects.suggestedFix: Define method/accuracy dependencies or remove FT where answers are independently marked.
defects.regressionTest: Validate every FT note against at least one explicit M/A dependency.

defects.current: The 755 lesson exam questions contain no explicit AO metadata; only the 213 bank questions inherit assessment-level AO lists.
defects.evidence: Question inventory count is 968 = 755 lesson + 213 bank; lesson question objects expose prompt, answer, marks, marking and strict fields only.
defects.officialBasis: The requested requirement x assessment x AO matrix needs auditable AO evidence.
defects.impact: AO balance for most questions cannot be independently verified without inference.
defects.suggestedFix: Add reviewed question-level AO metadata or a separate stable mapping.
defects.regressionTest: Reject Unknown AO values before release approval.
